prompts:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for a gentle Czech children's story-sequencing game for age seven.
Create a portrait image with EXACTLY THREE equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows, making twelve equal square panels, full image ratio 3:4. Each panel independently framed with an ample safe margin. The imaginary grid divisions must be exactly at 1/3 and 2/3 width and 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 height, because software crops the image by equal portions.
Every row is one three-step story, in time order from left to right. Same child, clothes, environment, and objects throughout each row. No part of a scene crosses into another cell. Friendly simple children's book illustration with thick clean contours, very large unambiguous actions and objects, flat soft colors, pale cream background, minimal setting, no decorative clutter, no visual strain. One complete scene in each panel.
No gutters, no drawn panel borders, no speech bubbles, no text, no numbers, no symbols indicating order, no arrows, no logos, no watermarks. Do not merge scenes. Exactly twelve scenes.
Row 1: panel 1 child accidentally tips a glass of water on a table, visible spill; panel 2 child takes a cloth beside the puddle on the same table; panel 3 child wipes the table dry with that cloth.
Row 2: panel 1 child holds up clearly muddy dirty hands; panel 2 same child washes hands with water at a sink; panel 3 same child dries clean hands on a towel.
Row 3: panel 1 child holds one seed over a pot of soil; panel 2 child waters the planted seed in the same pot; panel 3 a small green seedling now grows in that pot beside the pleased child.
Row 4: panel 1 child indoors looks at rain through a window; panel 2 same child sits putting on rain boots; panel 3 same child outdoors in those rain boots splashes in a puddle.
